Alex: FYI perf-bot just alerted a regression on Mixtral-8B runs (seq=2048). p50 ~+7% since last kernel-selector tweak. anyone seen this? :thinking:
perf-bot: REGRESSION DETECTED: model=mixtral-8b workload=long-context (seq=2048) metric=p50 latency delta=+7.1% baseline=21.4ms current=22.9ms traces=15
Priya: ugh. timeline? when did selector change land?
Kamil: it rolled in with last week's runtime patch that adjusted kernel preference heuristics (prefer Triton-optimized kernels for sdpa/flash mapping).
Jonah: quick profiler dump please — maybe fallback is happening more often.
Kamil: dumped one noisy request, here's the relevant slice from runtime log (truncated):
```
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] kernel_selector: trying FlashAttention (flash) for attn(head_dim=12, seq=2048)
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] flash: incompatible head_dim=12 (not multiple of 8) -> skipping
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] kernel_selector: trying Triton SDPA kernel
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] triton: kernel compiled with pad=16, runtime requests pad=8 -> mismatch, fallback to slowpath
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] fallback: executing generic SDPA slowpath (no shared mem kernels)
```
Kamil: so the selector is preferring Triton but the compiled specialization doesn't match runtime pad causing fallback to generic slowpath. that explains the p50 drift.
Sara: also noticed several Mixtral/Qwen variants have head_dim=12 or 6 due to model meta. FlashAttention requires 8/16 alignment on our GPU kernels — any mismatch -> performance cliff.
Priya: do we have a KV cache/mask alignment issue too? I remember a mask-shape bug surfaced with RoPE scaling where mask dims got transposed causing flash kernels to reject.
Jonah: I reproduced locally: when RoPE scale=config_scale!=1.0 we end up with mask offsets added in float and then floor->int, leading to off-by-one for some tokens. Flash's mask-check rejects it because mask != expected contiguous layout. patch was in 0.9.2 but maybe our selector change bypassed that guard.
Alex: can you paste the small repro command and results?
Jonah: here — quick run that flags fallback rate: `./run_bench --model mixtral-8b --seq 2048 --profile --seed 42` -> fallback_rate: 32% triton-fallback, 18% generic-slowpath (was <3% before).
Sara: more context: Mixtral's head_kv dims are nonstandard (head_dim=12, kv_head_dim=48 for some layers). Triton kernels were JITed for 16-pad and earlier logic assumed padable dims. After selector tweaks we select Triton for more shapes but compilation cache lacks the matching specializations for 12 -> leads to fallback to slowpath which is much slower than Flash for these shapes.
Priya: action items? quick mitigation: revert selector change or teach selector to check compiled specialization cache first.
Kamil: short-term patch: selector should consult kernel_cache.lookup(model, head_dim, pad) before choosing Triton. If no match, prefer Flash (with explicit prepad to 16) or fallback to forcing runtime pad policy to align heads via KV padding.
Alex: is prepadding safe for correctness (roperotation accuracy)? need to ensure RoPE scaling alignment doesn't break semantics.
Jonah: prepadding only affects internal kernel shape; we must ensure RoPE's sin/cos indexing uses the padded indices correctly. easy fix: compute sin/cos for padded dim, zero-out extra dims after compute. accuracy impact negligible in tests.
Priya: can we roll a small canary for high-traffic customers? and add a perf check to block if p50 > baseline+3%?
Kamil: I'll add two changes in the next PR: (1) kernel_selector: consult compiled-specialization cache, prefer Flash when Triton spec missing; (2) runtime: opt-in `align_heads_to=8|16` flag per model that pads KV/heads at load-time. also add unit tests for head_dim in {6,12,24} shapes.
Alex: sounds good. target timeline?
Kamil: PR today, canary tomorrow. I'll include microbench numbers in PR description.
perf-bot: BENCHMARK (canary): mixtral-8b seq=2048 before=21.4ms after=21.6ms change=+0.9% (canary small sample)
Sara: please also add a regression test that runs a short eval with RoPE scale !=1.0 to catch mask-transpose regressions.
Jonah: will add that. also logging: increase diagnostic verbosity for kernel_selector when fallback rate >10% so we can triage without repro.
Priya: timeline approved. can we add an alert so customer-facing SLAs don't trigger? maybe auto-fallback to last-known-good kernel map for dedicated customers.
Alex: good idea. deploy-bot, schedule canary rollout to runtime-stable tomorrow 09:00 UTC?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime-selector-patch -> runtime-stable (10% nodes) @ 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. Will monitor perf-bot and send alerts.
Kamil: I'll update the PR with a link to a small script that patches model meta to set `align_heads_to=16` for Mixtral/Qwen variants as emergency config.
Alex: thanks all. follow-up tomorrow with canary numbers. :thumbsup:
